messages:
nate_cs: Heads-up: MapleWorks wants a complex renewal. They want to allocate 30 seats across 3 entities (US parent, UK Ltd, APAC Pte), split invoices per entity, accept bank transfer only for the UK entity, and require an escrow holdback of 15% until onboarding is complete. They also asked that APAC sign via notarized wet-signature. Can Finance & Legal confirm feasibility?
irene_sales: That is a lot. Manager pre-approves seat allocation if economics unchanged. Need confirmation on currency per entity and whether escrow is cash hold or letter of credit. Who owns approval for escrow?
marta_fin: Finance: split invoices fine. For UK bank-transfer we need IBAN + remittance instructions; net45 is ok but bank-transfer means manual reconciliation. Escrow: we can holdback on invoice as a credit memo line (15% retention) rather than separate escrow account. A bank escrow/LOC is possible but requires Procurement Ops and billing ops signoff. Also need VAT number for UK and GST/HST or equivalent for APAC entity.
vikas_legal: Notarized wet-sign for APAC is unusual but acceptable if they provide local notary stamp. We'll require an attestation clause and explicit signatory name/title. If they insist on escrow agency, we need third-party escrow agreement — that'll extend timeline. Recommend credit-hold line on invoice to keep it simple.
nate_cs: Customer insists on third-party escrow agent because their procurement policy mandates it for onboarding credits > $50k. The total ARR change is $180k so 15% retention would be > $25k. They prefer bank escrow.
irene_sales: If escrow extends timeline, can we offer a compromise: 10% retention as invoice credit + escrow for remaining 5%? Approve with manager?
marta_fin: Finance would prefer a single approach. Partial escrow + retention ok but operationally complex. For bank escrow we need bank details, escrow instructions, and legal counsel to review. That will add ~2 weeks. If timeline is tight, credit memo retention is fastest.
vikas_legal: I'll draft two amendment options: (A) invoice retention 15% credited until onboarding sign-off; (B) third-party escrow with agent agreement (requires vendor review). Also include notarized-sign acceptance clause for APAC: "Scanned notarized page plus notary seal must be attached; such scanned page shall be treated as execution for this amendment."
docu_sign_bot: DocuSign envelope placeholder created (mw-2024-escrow). Setting APAC signer to manual upload to accept notarized wet-sign.
nate_cs: MapleWorks also asked that invoices show both USD and local currency lines for clarity. Finance OK with that?
marta_fin: Yes we can include dual-currency breakdown. We will invoice in each entity's base currency if remit requested; otherwise USD with local currency reference. FX note will be added: conversion based on invoice date.
irene_sales: Manager agrees to the hybrid 10% retention + 5% escrow only if legal estimates <2-week review. Otherwise choose full 15% retention. Please surface both amendment drafts to customer.
ate_cs: I'll send the two options to MapleWorks and request their preferred route plus escrow agent details and notary contact. Target: choose option by 2024-03-20 so Billing can prepare.
\vmika_legal_catch: (note) Vikas: also include clause to prevent double credits if onboarding not completed due to customer delay.
vikas_legal: Good catch, added.
docu_sign_bot: Status update: envelope mw-2024-escrow queued. Manual-upload mode for APAC signer ready.
ate_cs: Thanks team. I'll post customer choice and PO mapping once they return. :handshake:
